'''Volume 3''' is the third of four omnibus volumes of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. It was published by [[Shogakukan Asia]] in {{pmin|Singapore}}, although it uses [[VIZ Media]]'s translation. This volume contains all the chapters originally found in {{PAV|19}} and {{PAV|20}}.

==Major events==
{{spoilers}}
* {{adv|Ruby}} stops rampaging {{p|Grumpig}}. {{adv|Sapphire}} is shocked by the revelation of his abilities as a battler.
* Sapphire asks Ruby to help her fight against [[Team Aqua]] and [[Team Magma]]. He declines.
* [[Tate and Liza]] fight [[Blaise]] in [[Mt. Pyre]]. Blaise manages to steal the [[Red Orb|Red]] and [[Blue Orb]]s.
* [[Maxie]] and [[Archie]] decide to co-operate and travel to the [[Seafloor Cavern]] together.
* [[Winona]] gives Sapphire the {{badge|Feather}}.
* Ruby participates in the Hyper Rank Pokémon Contests in flooded [[Slateport City]].
* Ruby hurts [[Feefee]]'s feelings, and she flees.
* {{p|Kyogre}} and {{p|Groudon}} awaken.
* Sapphire finds a {{p|Relicanth}}.
* Ruby decides to help everybody, and he and Sapphire travel to the Seafloor Cavern on Relicanth.
* [[Professor Birch]] loses [[Emerald's Sceptile|Treecko]] and the Pokédex he was going to give to the {{adv|Emerald|third Hoenn Pokédex Holder}} he was supposed to meet. 
* {{adv|Wally}} finds the {{p|Treecko}} and the Pokédex in [[Pacifidlog Town]].
* [[Norman]] takes Wally to the [[Sky Pillar]]. Wally needs to climb to the tower's top.
* [[Archie]] receives the [[Blue Orb]] and is able to control {{p|Kyogre}}. He abandons {{adv|Amber}} into the [[Submarine Explorer 1]].
* {{adv|Ruby}} and {{adv|Sapphire}} reach the [[Seafloor Cavern]].
* [[Courtney]] invades the [[Mossdeep Space Center]].
* The [[Gym Leader]]s fight the [[Aqua Admin (Trainer class)|Team Aqua]] and [[Magma Admin (Trainer class)|Team Magma Admins]].
* The orbs take over [[Maxie]] and Archie's minds.
* Kyogre, {{p|Groudon}}, Maxie, and Archie make their way to [[Sootopolis City]]. Maxie and Archie drag Ruby and Sapphire with them.
